description: Find overlaps in tags and categories. Give `tags` and/or `categories` (or `terms`), one per line, optionally with usage counts as 'term (12)'. Groups terms that are the same once case, plurals and punctuation are ignored, same words in a different order, differing by spacing or hyphen, or one or two letters apart; says when a group spans both lists; suggests the most-used (else shortest) term to keep; lists possible parent and child pairs where one term's words are all inside another's; and lists terms used once or never when counts are given. Matching is by spelling, so true synonyms need a human.

terms.description: A single list when you do not separate tags and categories

name: taxonomy_overlap
title: Taxonomy overlap
